- **[[ViT]]充当“特征提取器”**：模型首先使用一个在大规模数据集（如[[DINOv2]]）上预训练好的ViT来理解图像。ViT会将图片切分成一个个小块（patches），并通过自注意力机制，从全局角度理解图像中不同部分的关系，从而提取出丰富的图像特征[](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/abs/pii/S1566253525000247)[](https://www.ultralytics.com/zh/glossary/vision-transformer-vit)[](https://cloud.baidu.com/article/5595322)。
    
- **解码器生成深度图**：在ViT提取出特征后，模型的后半部分（通常是一个叫DPT的解码器）会把这些特征“翻译”成最终的深度图[](https://models.luxonis.com/luxonis/depth-anything-v2/c5bf9763-d29d-4b10-8642-fbd032236383?backTo=%2F%3FbackTo%3D%252F%253FbackTo%253D%25252F%25253FbackTo%25253D%2525252F%2525253FbackTo%2525253D%252525252F%252525253FbackTo%252525253D%25252525252F%25252525253FbackTo%25252525253D%2525252525252F%2525252525253FbackTo%2525252525253D%252525252525252F%252525252525253FbackTo%252525252525253D%25252525252525252F%25252525252525253FbackTo%25252525252525253D%2525252525252525252F%2525252525252525253FbackTo%2525252525252525253D%252525252525252525252F%252525252525252525253FbackTo%252525252525252525253D%25252525252525252525252F%25252525252525252525253FbackTo%25252525252525252525253D%2525252525252525252525252F%2525252525252525252525253FbackTo%2525252525252525252525253D%252525252525252525252525252F%252525252525252525252525253Fsearch%252525252525252525252525253Dscrfd)[](https://deepwiki.com/thygate/stable-diffusion-webui-depthmap-script/7.3-depth-anything-models)。
